text: Easy to install in Win11, no drivers, works with VoiceMeeter so it can be used with apps such as Sayintentions or vPilot as an additional input source.

title: Works but very quiet at max volume.  Could use a powered pre-amp
text:
It does what it says but it's very quiet.  I've upped the volume on the headset and Windows and you can barely hear.  This device could use a 9 volt powered pre-amp.  This is likely due to the impedance of most aviation headsets being over 200 ohms.

I hope a powered version comes out one day.  I don't know enough about electronics to hack the circuit board and it's all surface mounted components inside.  Above my skillset, sadly.

title: Fantastic item that works with my David Clark headset to allow PC use.
text: I was looking for an easy way to use my test flight David Clark headset with my PC because I really like the headset.  This product allowed me to do that with ease and no issues.  Sounds great and mic works great.

title: Put your old aviation headset back to work
text: I've been looking for something like this for a while. I love that it can be mounted under the desk. I have had a David Clark headset just lying around unused, this module works great with them. I had an issue with connectivity at first, but I just needed to clean the plugs on my headset; they were pretty badly oxidized. The audio is a bit low, but not unusable. Considering what aviation headsets are used for, this is not unreasonable. I mainly use these in Teams calls and I can hear everyone perfectly. Overall this was a great purchase that let me put my old and very expensive aviation headset back to work.

title: General aviation headset adapter to PC use
text: So far works as expected, looks good quality. Delivery was fast 👍

title: Not a bad product, but some faults need to be addressed before your purchase
text:
Listening-wise, the headset adapter sounds great.
However, not sure if that's my problem or the product fault
The mic is unusable with extremely poor audio quality.
I'm using the Bose A30 headset, whether I turn on the ANC or not. The mic communication is still unusable in every situation.
Also, if I turn on the Bluetooth of my headset while I plug the headset into the adapter, there is extreme interference noise that will make it unusable.

with the price tag like this, i expected it to perform a lot better.

title: Good audio but no cable
text: It works well and the audio is good quality, I’m not giving 5 stars because I received it without USB cable.
